meaning: separate observation/measurement state rank for z_obs; no biology qualification claim
selection_metric: held-operator reconstruction score for lawful observation descriptors; larger is better
selection_rule: Choose the smallest positive rank whose held-operator reconstruction mean is within one held-operator SE of the best tested rank, provided the best tested rank is not the search boundary.
boundary_rule: If the best held-operator reconstruction rank equals the highest tested rank, return EXPAND_OBSERVATION_SEARCH_ENVELOPE and do not select numeric D_obs.
held_source_role: diagnostic only when lawful technology descriptors are independently mapped; source identity itself is never a target
